'''Corrupted Wolves''' are mid-level monsters found in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]]. Their counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet|Gauntlet]] is the [[Crystalline Wolf]]. Mid-level monsters always spawn in pairs, if they spawn in a room.
